kind.label: Kind
kind.description: Grow a mound of moss, or only paint its colour onto the rock

items.label: Mound
items.description: A low mound of moss with its own printed texture

items.label: Texture Only
items.description: No geometry: the dabs are painted into the rock's colour map when the scene is exported (Blender shows them on a decal that is not exported)

detail.label: Detail
detail.description: How fine the moss is grown: at 0.5 the dabs and texels are twice as big and a build takes about a quarter of the time. Where the colours fall is kept. Lower it for moss far in the background

mound_density.label: Triangles / m²
mound_density.description: Poly count: the mound is decimated to this many triangles per square metre (at most what Resolution gives)

texel.label: Texel Size
texel.description: Texture quality: the size of a texel of the print in the world; smaller is sharper

max_texture.label: Max Texture
max_texture.description: Largest side of the print; where the mound does not fit at Texel Size, its texels grow. The export encodes at most 4096

items.description: At most 256 x 256 px
At most 512 x 512 px
At most 1024 x 1024 px
At most 2048 x 2048 px
At most 4096 x 4096 px

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.description: Edge length the rock is refined to under the paint

threshold.label: Threshold
threshold.description: Paint coverage at which moss starts

layers.label: Layers
layers.description: Lighter layers grown inside the dark base

shrink.label: Shrink
shrink.description: Dab radius from one layer to the next (floored at 0.65)

buffer.label: Buffer
buffer.description: How far inside the layer below a lighter layer stays

first_buffer.label: First Buffer
first_buffer.description: How far inside the dark base the first lighter layer stays

min_clump.label: Min Clump
min_clump.description: Clumps of fewer dabs are dropped

dark.label: Dark
dark.description: The darkest moss: the base and the rim

levels.label: Levels
levels.description: Tone steps from darkest to lightest

ref_depth.label: Reference Depth
ref_depth.description: A patch this deep reaches the lightest tone; shallower patches stay mid-green

steps_deep.label: Steps
steps_deep.description: Erosion passes across the reference depth

erode_scale.label: Erosion Noise
erode_scale.description: 1/m: how finely each erosion pass's outline is roughened

field_mix.label: Field Mix
field_mix.description: Tone from the erosion field (1) or from the layer (0)

curve.label: Curve
curve.description: Tone curve: above 1 keeps the light to the summits

mottle.label: Mottle
mottle.description: Slow positional variation, in tone steps

floor.label: Floor
floor.description: How proud of the rock the darkest moss stands, away from the rim

lift.label: Lift
lift.description: How much prouder the lightest moss stands than the darkest: the lighter, the taller

up_floor.label: Wall Share
up_floor.description: The share of its height moss keeps on a wall (a full pile on a wall faces the ground)

height_blur.label: Height Blur
height_blur.description: How far the height is smoothed, so blotches are pillows, not terraces

rim.label: Rim
rim.description: Distance over which the height fades in from the mound's edge

drape.label: Drape
drape.description: The tightest curve the moss bends in: across a step or hollow tighter than this it slopes from the edge down to the moss below instead of following the rock's corner. 0 follows the rock

emission_strength.label: Emission
emission_strength.description: Brightness of the lighter patches (Mound only); add game lights for illumination

emission_threshold.label: Glow Threshold
emission_threshold.description: Only tones above this fraction of Dark to Light glow; the dark rim stays matte

edge_kind.label: Edge
edge_kind.description: How the mound's edge is drawn

items.label: Printed
items.description: The outline is in the print: its alpha is the distance to the dabs' outline, the material cuts the moss there and shades a rolled lip inside it. The mesh runs a little past the outline and costs only what the mound's area costs

items.label: Mesh
items.description: The mesh is cut along the dabs' outline, rounded over and skirted under its lip: hundreds of triangles a metre of outline

edge_apron.label: Apron
edge_apron.description: How far past the outline the mesh runs before the print cuts it (never less than a refined edge and a half)

edge_round.label: Edge Round
edge_round.description: How far in from its outline the moss's top rounds down to its lip

overhang.label: Overhang
overhang.description: How high the lip stands over the rock and how far its foot is tucked in under it (at most half of Floor)

edge_detail.label: Edge Detail
edge_detail.description: Edge length of the mesh along the outline: the smaller, the rounder its lobes

strays.label: Strays
strays.description: Detached clumps of moss on the rock beyond the outline, per metre of outline

stray_reach.label: Stray Reach
stray_reach.description: How far beyond the outline a stray clump may be

grass.label: Grass
grass.description: Tufts of grass blades per square metre of the moss's up-facing top, more where it is lighter

grass_height.label: Grass Height
grass_height.description: How tall the tallest blades stand

grass_tip.label: Grass Tip
grass_tip.description: The lightest blade tip; the tips run from Light to this

min_patch.label: Min Patch
min_patch.description: Mound islands smaller than this are dropped (stray clumps are kept)

print_edge.label: Dab Edge
print_edge.description: Anti-aliased width of a dab's edge in the print

items.label: Leaves
items.description: A card per leaf, in sheets that shade one another: ivy near the gameplay plane

items.label: Clumps
items.description: A card per clump of leaves: ivy on the backdrop, at a fraction of the cards

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.description: Edge length the host is refined to under the paint; the underlay's and the candidates' resolution

threshold.label: Threshold
threshold.description: Paint coverage at which ivy starts; higher shrinks the patch inside the painted area

min_patch.label: Min Patch
min_patch.description: Islands smaller than this are dropped

rounding.label: Rounding
rounding.description: How far the rock's creases are rounded over in the normal the leaves shade with

thickness.label: Thickness
thickness.description: How high the leaves stand over the underlay at the origin; they slope down to the rock at the far end of the carpet

tilt.label: Tilt
tilt.description: Degrees a leaf pitches tip-up off the rock, so its tip rides over the leaf beyond it

spread.label: Spread
spread.description: Degrees a leaf may stray from pointing straight away from the origin

taper.label: Taper
taper.description: How much smaller the leaves at the far end of the carpet are than those at the origin

clump_fill.label: Fill
clump_fill.description: Clump area laid over the paint, as a multiple of the paint's area

edge_fill.label: Edge Fill
edge_fill.description: Extra fill toward the paint's edge, so the underlay never shows as a rim

edge_round.label: Edge Round
edge_round.description: Distance in from the paint's edge over which the carpet curves down onto the rock: shorter is a steeper edge

underlay.label: Underlay
underlay.description: Height of the solid green skin under the leaves

sheets.label: Sheets
sheets.description: Sheets of leaves stacked 3 cm apart, each shading the next

leaf_fill.label: Fill
leaf_fill.description: Leaf area laid over the paint, as a multiple of the paint's area, shared by the sheets

density.label: Candidates
density.description: Candidate points per square metre the sheets pick leaves from

vine_length.label: New Length
vine_length.description: Length a newly placed vine is given; scale its arrow (S) to change one

leaf_size.label: Leaf Size
leaf_size.description: Leaf length at the top of a vine

leaf_tip.label: Leaf Tip
leaf_tip.description: Leaf length at the tip of a vine

tone_a.label: Yellow-green
tone_a.description: The first of three tones that patch across the carpet

light.label: Crown
light.description: What a leaf turns toward where the rock faces up

shade.label: Shade
shade.description: What the lower sheets cool toward

depth_shade.label: Depth Shade
depth_shade.description: How much darker the lower sheets are

shadow_strength.label: Strength
shadow_strength.description: Opacity of the shadow under the carpet; 0 grows none

shadow_reach.label: Reach
shadow_reach.description: How far beside the paint's edge the shadow fades out

shadow_drop.label: Drop
shadow_drop.description: How much further the shadow reaches below the paint than beside it

items.label: Painted Fronds
items.description: Each frond one painted card, folded down its midrib

items.label: Leaflets
items.description: Each frond a stem with pairs of small painted leaves

items.label: Leaf Sprigs
items.description: Painted sprigs along each stem, set like louvres: a leafy bush

fronds.label: Fronds
fronds.description: Fronds the clump tries to fit; a tight spot fits fewer

droop.label: Droop
droop.description: How far the fronds bend down toward their tips

spread.label: Spread
spread.description: Degrees the fronds open out from the clump's axis

lean.label: Lean
lean.description: How far the clump leans toward its open side (the plant's +Y)

fold.label: Midrib Fold
fold.description: How far each frond folds down its midrib

twist.label: Twist
twist.description: How much the fronds twist along their length

croziers.label: Fiddleheads
croziers.description: Young coiled fronds standing in the middle

length_var.label: Length Variation
length_var.description: How much the fronds' lengths vary

pinnae.label: Leaf Pairs
pinnae.description: Pairs of leaves (or leaflet stems) along each frond

leaflets.label: Tiny Leaves
leaflets.description: Tiny leaves a side on each leaflet stem; 0 sets single leaves straight on the frond

fern_leaf_size.label: Leaf Size
fern_leaf_size.description: Leaf size, as a multiple of the reference size

leaf_curve.label: Leaf Curve
leaf_curve.description: How curved the leaves are: the crease, the tip's curl and the sideways sweep

leaf_variation.label: Leaf Variation
leaf_variation.description: How much leaves vary in colour and size

items.label: Smooth
items.description: Leaves joined straight to the stem

items.label: Creased
items.description: Deeply folded leaves, overlapping like shingles

mirror_pairs.label: Mirror Pairs
mirror_pairs.description: The two leaves of a pair are mirror images, alike in size and colour

paint_tint.label: Paint Tint
paint_tint.description: How far the painted pieces' own colours are moved toward the chosen greens

vine_length.label: Length
vine_length.description: The stem's length along the rock and down from it

vine_leaf_size.label: Leaf Size
vine_leaf_size.description: Leaf length (painted leaves keep their sizes relative to one another)

leaf_spacing.label: Leaf Gap
leaf_spacing.description: Distance between leaves along the stem

vine_radius.label: Stem Radius
vine_radius.description: The stem's radius at its root; it tapers to a third at the tip

cling.label: Cling
cling.description: How long the stem holds to the rock over a steep side or an overhang before it lets go and hangs

bend.label: Bend
bend.description: How softly a hanging stem turns down

leaf_angle.label: Leaf Spread
leaf_angle.description: Degrees a leaf stands off the stem

variation.label: Variation
variation.description: How much leaves vary in size, angle, colour and rhythm

natural.label: Natural Leaves
natural.description: Gravity droop, curved blades, colour and size by age; off is the flat early look

items.label: Stemmed Caps
items.description: Umbrella caps with luminous gills

items.label: Wall Shelves
items.description: Thin fans projecting from a wall

cluster_radius.label: Cluster Radius
cluster_radius.description: Area over which individual attachments are placed

bio_size.label: Size
bio_size.description: Cap radius, orb radius, or frond half-width

bio_variation.label: Size Variation
bio_variation.description: Independent seeded variation in width and height

shape_variation.label: Shape Variation
shape_variation.description: Variation in cap profiles, bulb proportions, stem bends and frond curls

surface_detail.label: Surface Detail
surface_detail.description: Cap surface markings, soft orb lobe depth, and subtle frond twist; outlines stay smooth

bio_height.label: Height
bio_height.description: Stem height or frond length; shelves and orb stalks have their own proportions

cap_dome.label: Cap Dome
cap_dome.description: Cap height relative to radius; shelves use a quarter of this

glow_strength.label: Emission
glow_strength.description: Surface brightness; nearby game lights illuminate the surroundings

orb_stalk.label: Stalk Length
orb_stalk.description: Short individual stalk length, as a fraction of the bulb's diameter

items.label: Grove
items.description: A mushroom cluster with lantern blooms, ferns and reeds around it

items.label: Mushrooms
items.description: A cluster of glowing mushrooms on a mound

items.label: Lanterns
items.description: Arched stalks with hanging glowing bulbs

items.label: Ferns
items.description: Glow ferns with unfurling fiddleheads

items.label: Reeds
items.description: Blade tufts with glowing seed pods

items.label: High
items.description: Close-up detail

items.label: Mid
items.description: About half the triangles

items.label: Low
items.description: About an eighth of the triangles, for distant patches

glow_collisions.label: Keep Apart
glow_collisions.description: Move plants until nothing intersects another plant, the mound, the ground or itself, with room for the sway
